Camille: quick question — inbound proxy is sometimes stripping Authorization and X-Project headers. If a request comes in with no Authorization but with an API key in `x-api-key`, do we treat that as authoritative for org/project mapping? what error should we return when neither auth nor api-key is present? 401 or 403?

Ryan: short answer: API keys are valid credentials and can be used to infer org/project. precedence we agreed on is: Authorization (Bearer) > x-api-key > x-project (routing only). If none present -> 401. 403 = authenticated but forbidden. we used to have a 5min key-rotation grace in design but not implemented.

Anya: want to call out that `x-project` alone should never be treated as auth — it's just routing metadata. if proxies add it and strip auth, we should reject. also: what about legacy clients that send `X-Api` (capitalization/different name)? do we normalize? :thinking_face:

Ryan: we normalize header names lower-case in ingress. canonical names: `authorization`, `x-api-key`, `x-project`. legacy `X-Api` -> map to `x-api-key` for a deprecation window (30d). add to spec: "x-project is not authentication" line.

Mike: i'll implement enforcement in the runtime: return 401 for missing credentials, 403 only when scope check fails. i'll also add a metric `auth.missing_header` and a trace tag `auth_type=none|api_key|bearer`. PR incoming, will add e2e tests exercising proxy-strip cases. pinging @Ryan for where to add unit tests in auth-service. :white_check_mark:

Anya: also flagging key-rotation: if rotated key used within grace window should return 200 but emit `auth.key_rotated_grace` metric. agree 5m seems small for slow clients — can we make it configurable per org?

Ryan: configurable per org is fine; default 5m. implement as `rotation_grace_seconds` in org config. runtime reads it at auth-time.

Camille: SGTM. Mike — please include a short changelog entry and note for support about proxy behavior. once PR is ready we can roll the deprecation for `X-Api` and announce to infra teams so they stop rewriting headers. :loudspeaker:

deploy-bot: deploy queued for auth-service @auth-canary; expected start 2419991300.

Mike: launched a draft PR: https://git.internal/redwood/auth-service/pulls/412 — adds header normalization, 401 behavior, metrics, org rotation config. leaving TODO to add integration test for proxy that strips `authorization` but preserves `x-api-key`.

Camille: thanks — i'll loop in infra for proxy whitelist and notify support after merge.

Ryan: i'll update the spec doc with explicit precedence + deprecation timeline for `X-Api` and the new org config key.

Anya: thanks everyone. small follow-up: do we want a human-friendly error body for 401 that hints "missing credentials or header stripped by proxy"? could help debugging.

Mike: yep will include a short error message and a link to an internal troubleshooting page.

Camille: perfect. closing this q/a once PR merges. :+1:
